name: @sages/pi-orchestrator
description: Sages orchestrator for pi: session hooks (setActiveTools + system-prompt overlay + once-per-session soft-mode reminder) + the `orchestrate(plan)` convenience tool + the `/brainstorm` slash command. Workflows are driven by the LLM via raw `TaskCreate` × N + `TaskExecute`; `orchestrate` collapses the standard Implement → Review shape into one call. Domain capability package, loaded by pi via standard pi.extensions.
